notes.title: First Demo Update (v0.4.1)
notes.notes:
The first update for the SPACEROCKS Demo is now live! 



The main issue players have reported so far is that the UI is too small and a lot of the text difficult to read, so this update aims to address that by scaling up almost all UI and text elements in the game.

Information tabs have also been added to the Ship Upgrading interface to help new players navigate it.



PATCH NOTES 0.4.1



- Many text and UI elements have been scaled up in size.

- Added information tabs to the Ship Upgrade Screen.

- Fixed an issue where some leaderboards could not be scrolled.

- Fixed issues with changing window and resolution settings.

- Various minor gameplay bug fixes.
